title: Magic Cake
description: A simple batter splits into 3 distinct layers as it bakes in this beautiful magic cake that features creamy custard in the middle.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Beat egg whites in a large bowl with an electric mixer until stiff.

Combine egg yolks and white sugar in another large bowl; beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add butter and vanilla extract; beat until smooth, about 2 minutes. Fold in flour. Beat in milk slowly. Fold egg whites gently into the batter.
Pour batter into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is golden, 45 to 70 minutes. Let cool, about 30 minutes. Dust top with confectioners' sugar.

video.description: This white cake becomes a layered cake while you bake it low-and-slow! In this video, Chloe bakes a creamy magic cake with a custard-like texture. Dusted with powdered sugar over its browned outer layer, this decadent dessert is tender, packed with sweet flavor, and uses only one batter for three layers of cake. After baking the cake in the oven, garnish it with fresh berries for a special after-dinner treat!
